final_response: Replied to Priya at priya@vendor.com acknowledging the urgent login loop complaint, referencing ticket T-ext-E_CH_2_004 (high priority, open), and assuring her the team is actively working on it.

args.body:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for reaching out. We've received your complaint regarding the login loop issue and understand this is blocking your users — we sincerely apologize for the disruption.

We have an open ticket (T-ext-E_CH_2_004) tracking this with high priority and our team is actively working on a resolution. We will keep you updated as we make progress and will notify you as soon as it is resolved.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need further assistance in the meantime.

Best regards
